reuse.why: Hooks the new check into the existing withBankAccountLinkCheck wrapper that every provider link handler already goes through, next to assertBankAccountNotLinked.

duplication.why: A single assertion function; no logic is copied into the provider handlers or linkBankSyncAccount.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts beside the existing link precondition and runs before any write, sync or bank creation, as the tree's layering expects.

scope.why: Only the guard, its tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, named precondition in the shared wrapper; easy to find and covers all six providers at once.

one_place.where: assertUpgradingAccountNotClosed called from withBankAccountLinkCheck in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, which wraps every provider's link handler
